patterns.title: Manual Contract Redlining & Liability Cap Auditing
patterns.insight: Enterprise General Counsel and Legal Ops leads spend 20–30 hours weekly manually verifying indemnification caps, DPDP Act compliance, and jurisdiction clauses across multi-vendor agreements.

patterns.title: M&A Due Diligence & VDR Velocity Bottlenecks
patterns.insight: Private Equity analysts and M&A teams lose weeks searching virtual data rooms for hidden liabilities across hundreds of unindexed PDF documents.

patterns.title: Unindexed SLA & Penalty Triggers
patterns.insight: Procurement and IT Ops leads miss contractual SLA credit claims because vendor addendums are stored as static, unlinked files.

outreach_plan.angle: Offer a complimentary 10-document evidentiary audit test on anonymized sample agreements before proposing enterprise software deployment.
outreach_plan.first_step: Reach out to the top 3 highest-scoring prospects (Acme SaaS Legal Ops, Apex HealthTech, Starlight Capital) with a source-grounded question regarding their specific pain trigger.
outreach_plan.follow_up: Share a 2-minute recorded walkthrough of SYNAPS analyzing their specific clause format if they confirm the bottleneck.
outreach_plan.success: Secure 4 exploratory discovery calls and 2 design-partner POC commitments within 7 days.

limits: These are potential early customers inferred from public professional signals and public event transcripts, not confirmed buyers.
Verify current contract renewal dates and compliance deadlines before initiating outreach.
All outreach must remain manual, low-volume, and strictly source-grounded.
